ontology.note: Generation emits a computation receipt and GeoSPARQL point feature collection; full port SHACL remains future work.

changes.description: Generalised in place. The computation was always general -- a bounding extent, a metre spacing converted to degrees at the extent's mid-latitude, and an even-odd containment test -- but the widget declared itself example-specific and earned it three ways: it was titled 'Sample locations', described as generating 'demonstration points', and defined inside one worked example's module in OLD_TYPES. It also stamped samplingBasis 'demonstration-grid' onto every point it produced, which is a claim about a demonstration rather than about a grid. The operation now lives in src/point-grid.ts with no default geometry, the title is 'Point grid', the stamp reads 'regular-grid', and the widget is on the shared palette instead of one example's template. No new node type and no migration: a saved workflow holding this node loads unchanged and no example's node count moves. The spacing range check moved to src/core.ts with it, because validateOldNode only runs for OLD_TYPES members and leaving it behind would have silently stopped enforcing 150-1000 m.

evidence.note: Repository regression coverage exists; this release entry does not certify a widget independently.
